{{Top}}
'''Repulsor fields''' were generated by [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|craft]] power by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> They were also created by [[Force field/Legends|energy field]] projectors that were used on many emplacements and stations set in harsh environments. One large station that used a repulsor field was the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] headquarters on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], because of the dangerous [[Magma/Legends|lava]] rivers and gases that could damage the station.

There was a repulsor field on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] near [[Ploughtekal Market]], where a [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|duel]] was fought in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Repulsor fields could vary in size and scale; the [[GH-7 medical analysis unit]] featured a repulsor field that kept sensitive liquids from spilling on its tray.

Repulsor fields were used in [[hyperbaric medical chamber]]s to vary the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. This allowed individuals using the chamber who could not move in normal gravity a degree of movement.<ref name="SOTESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
